approved_source_strings.must_have_attributes: Sturdy mop system. 2-Piece pole is easy to assemble. Lightweight and durable. 18" mop head. Easy fill bottle with cartridge technology. Closed loop system reduces the opportunity for chemicals to come in direct contact with users. Eliminates dilution errors.
approved_source_strings.pack_inclusions: 1 Mop; 1 Microfiber Wet Mop Pad 5 in. x 19.25 in / 12.7 cm x 48.9 cm; 12 Multi-Surface Floor Cleaner Cartridges 0.33 FL. OZ. / 9.7 mL Each; Total 4 FL. OZ. / 118.3 mL
marketplace_bullets: ExpressMop spray mop system for quick and efficient cleaning
Includes twelve multi-surface floor cleaner cartridges
Features a reusable 18" microfiber wet mop pad for wide coverage
Ergonomic trigger for even solution dispensing
Constructed with a durable aluminum pole for long-lasting use
Designed for indoor use on hard floors
Suitable for all hard floors not harmed by water including sealed wood, linoleum, terrazzo, marble, vinyl, rubber, and tile flooring
Compatible with Coastwide Professional ExpressRefill Multi-Surface Floor Cleaner (CW053ER24-A), Disposable Mop Pads (CW63404), and Launderable Mop Pads (CW61066)
approved_source_strings.headliner: Tackle high-traffic areas effortlessly with the Coastwide ExpressMop Starter Kit, designed for quick and efficient cleaning.
